headlines.title: Luigi Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO while pleading guilty to federal charges
headlines.description: Mangione was charged with two federal stalking counts and faces a maximum penalty of life in prison in the 2024 killing of United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione’s lawyers speak after he pleads guilty to federal charges
headlines.description: Following Luigi Mangione’s guilty plea in federal court, his defense lawyer said Mangione “accepts full responsibility" for the death of Brian Thompson, and announced the filing of a double jeopardy motion to drop the New York state charges.

headlines.title: Trump downplays concerns about conditions aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
headlines.description: President Donald Trump dismissed concerns from families of service members about the conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. When asked by NBC News whether the deployments have gone on for too long, Trump replied “not nearly long enough.” NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Woman arrested and facing felony charges in World War II Memorial vandalism case, DOJ says
headlines.description: A woman accused of vandalizing the World War II Memorial has been arrested in Washington, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro announced Friday.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday asked the Supreme Court to allow him to continue construction of a sprawling ballroom adjacent to the White House.

headlines.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism, found dead week after resigning
headlines.description: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position after accusations of plagiarism.

headlines.title: Haitians in Maryland live in fear over ICE detentions after end of their TPS status
headlines.description: More than 350,000 Haitians lost Temporary Protected Status as the Trump administration ramps up ICE arrests. In Maryland, a 17-year-old watched how ICE detained her father and a widowed father fears he too will be arrested. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: FBI reports record decrease in violent crime in 2025
headlines.description: Both the violent crime and murder rates have decreased annually since spiking in 2022, the bureau has found. President Donald Trump touted the statistics Friday.
